## The situation

You are spending a simulated day as Ajaia's Marketing Associate. Ajaia's podcast has not launched yet, and this week the team is prepping the first episode. It is a normal, slightly chaotic stretch: the launch episode needs a clip plan, the channels need something new, and two people in the materials below do not fully agree with each other. All names, numbers, and messages below are fictional composites built for this exercise.

**Material D. From Ajaia's brand voice note (internal, one page)**

> Plain and confident, not loud. No "unlock," no "seamless," no "game-changing," no "cutting-edge." If a sentence would work on any AI company's homepage, rewrite it until it only works on ours. We say what changed, not what might change.

## Tasks

**Task 1. Think piece** (suggested 35 minutes)

Write a piece for LinkedIn arguing a position on AI that an enterprise buyer, someone who has already sat through a failed pilot, would actually stop scrolling for. 300 words minimum. No maximum. Have a point of view. Take a position someone could disagree with. Do not write a summary of what AI is. If we can predict your third sentence from your first, it is not working. Nothing you cannot support. No invented statistics.

**Task 2. Channel execution set** (suggested 30 minutes)

Build one of the following, using only public material from ajaia.ai:

- A short-form video cut (30 to 60 seconds), any platform, or
- A carousel (3 to 5 slides) plus a caption written for that platform, not repurposed from another one.

Pick the platform first and say which one. Deliver the piece plus three sentences on why you made the choices you made, including anything you deliberately left out.

**Task 3. Podcast launch task** (suggested 25 minutes)

Using Material C, plan the three clips you would cut from the launch episode. For each clip: the timestamp range, a title, and the hook (the first line someone hears or reads). Then write the show notes for the full episode, 150 words or fewer.

**Task 4. AI Workflow Note** (100 words max, suggested 10 minutes)

Name the AI tools you used and what for. Name the single most useful thing AI produced for you today and the single worst, and what you did about the worst.

**Video** (suggested 15 minutes, recorded inside the 120-minute window, screen plus camera where there is something to show)

Record 5 to 8 minutes of yourself. Walk through what you made first: the think piece's position and why you took it, the channel piece and the choices behind it, and the podcast clip plan, including anything you deliberately left out or any conflict in the materials you noticed. Close with who you are, why this role and why Ajaia, and your salary expectations. Do not state your current or most recent compensation anywhere in this video or in your submission.

## Submission checklist

- Task 1 written piece, 300 words or more
- Task 2 channel piece plus three sentences
- Task 3 clip plan and show notes
- Task 4 AI Workflow Note
- Video, 5 to 8 minutes, walkthrough followed by who you are, why Ajaia, and salary expectations
- Optional: links to your own work, if you have them
- A reference to ajaia.ai appears somewhere in the materials
- Every link opens for someone who is not you. Check this in a private browser window.
